15"""Atlas A5 (Ascend950DT / Ascend950PR, NpuArch DAV_3510) specializations. 

16 

17``_ascend/__init__.py`` resolves the arch key ``a5`` in ``get_arch_key`` when 

18``ARCH`` says so or the driver reports an Ascend950 SoC, and 

19``runtime.backend.BackendArchEvent`` then loads 

20this directory and overrides the matching entries of ``_ascend/ops`` (A2/A3 

21baseline) and ``flag_gems.ops`` (generic). Every operator placed under 

22``a5/ops`` and exported from ``a5/ops/__init__.py`` wins over both on A5 only; 

23nothing here is reachable on Ascend910B*. 

24 

25Optional per-arch files, all picked up by ``BackendArchEvent`` when present: 

26 

27* ``tune_configs.yaml`` -- ``triton.autotune`` configs, consulted before 

28 ``_ascend/tune_configs.yaml``. 

29* ``heuristics_config_utils.py`` -- must define ``HEURISTICS_CONFIGS``, which 

30 has to be re-exported from this file to be visible to the loader. 

31* ``enable_configs.yaml`` -- per-arch operator include/exclude lists. 

32 

33Note on imports: this package is imported under its bare name ``a5`` (via 

34``sys.path`` injection), not as ``flag_gems.runtime.backend._ascend.a5``, so it 

35has no parent package at runtime. Modules under ``a5/ops`` must reach shared 

36code through absolute imports (``from flag_gems.runtime.backend._ascend import 

37heuristics_config_utils``, ``from flag_gems.utils import libentry``); a 

38relative ``from ..utils import CORE_NUM`` raises ImportError. 

39 

40Keep this file free of operator imports. ``BackendArchEvent`` imports it while 

41``flag_gems.runtime`` is still initializing (``configs_loader`` builds the 

42event to read the arch configs), so pulling in ``a5/ops`` from here would 

43import ``flag_gems.ops``/``flag_gems.runtime`` mid-initialization and fail with 

44a circular import. The loader imports ``a5.ops`` later, on its own. 

45"""
